mapper.sql: act_announcement.actannouncement_num, act_announcement.activity_num, act_announcement.actannouncement_id, act_announcement.actannouncement_name, act_announcement.actannouncement_detail, act_announcement.organization_num, activity.activity_name
mapper.select:
select
from act_announcement, activity where act_announcement.activity_num = activity.activity_num and act_announcement.actannouncement_isdeleted = 0 and activity.activity_isdeleted = 0 and exists (select 1 from participate where participate.activity_num = act_announcement.activity_num and participate.volunteer_num = #{volunteerNum,jdbcType=INTEGER} and participate.participate_applystate in ('0', '1', '3') and participate.participate_isdeleted = 0) order by act_announcement.actannouncement_num desc
select coalesce(max(cast(substring(actannouncement_id, 5) as unsigned)), 0) + 1 from act_announcement where actannouncement_id like 'ann%' and char_length(actannouncement_id) = 9
